title: The data of factory.limit-changed
description: A write changed the factory's limit, or a consumer saw it change. tehas limit --json without api, and observed. It has exactly one of set and observed. Version 1 of the events. host/docs/api.md, "Events", says what each field means. The object is closed; a minor release may add an optional field. console/tests/events_contract.rs checks the samples beside this file against it.

set.description: When the limit was written, as tehas limit --json prints it. The key and at.

observed.description: When a change with no set was observed: a clear, or a limit unreadable or gone. The key and at.
